We have consolidated dataset with 38 polymorphs across 15 compositions (some missing due to failures). Next steps: prepare tabular dataset with advanced feature engineering, test_split 0.2, normalize True, target property formation_energy_per_atom. Output path for dataset files.

We need to specify output_path base. Let's set base path: "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/ml_nitrides_trial_21/dataset". The tool will create files.
